market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.1m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Per CEIC/Trading Economics, Venezuela produced ~988k bpd in March 2026 (up from 909k in Feb), and other sources cite ~1.2m bpd in April. Trajectory is rising. Reaching 1.1m bpd in any 2026 month is probable given current momentum, even if April figure is overstated.
assessment.key_uncertainty: OPEC's secondary-source figures vary substantially from direct-comm; sanctions or unrest could reverse trend.
